title: Recovered-audio GA and constrained-Pareto integration
summary: The supplied audio_rexx_search_v0.12-dev5 remains the authoritative A/B/C/D/E caller. dev6 rebases onto it and adds non-breaking Strategy P using hard configuration constraints plus the recovered-audio Pareto objective vector.
authority: Supplied audio_rexx_search_v0.12-dev5 defines inherited A/B/C/D/E behaviour; the dev6 integration replacement defines Strategy P and ML provenance.
invariants: The audio score is lower-is-better; the evaluator returns the natural score and MLObjectiveFitnessAdapter performs inversion.
Normalized configuration caching remains authoritative for unique-evaluation counting.
GA search can use a narrower domain than grid lanes only if the difference is declared rather than silently compared as equivalent.
Final bred population must be scored before ranking/shortlisting ends.
The current 18/40 clipping penalties are experimental pending perceptual calibration.
Strategy P is additive; it must not silently change A/B/C/D/E search semantics inherited from the supplied audio v0.12-dev5 source.
Strategy P hard configuration/domain validity is assessed before objective scoring and cannot be traded against resemblance or clipping.
Strategy P materializes only the bounded feasible promoted frontier.
procedure: Create MLGeneticPolicy(.25,.12,.80,2) by name rather than opaque positional intent.
Call ga~run(plan~breedingSteps), not a terminal loop of ga~step().
Rank unique scored records, then materialize only the declared shortlist.
Feed pairwise listening evidence into MLObjectiveCalibration before treating objective weights as calibrated.
For Strategy P, combine AudioParetoObjectives with MLConstraintSet and MLConstrainedEvaluatorAdapter.
Run MLConstrainedParetoGeneticAlgorithm under MLGABudgetPlan/MLGeneticPolicy and promote with MLConstrainedParetoRetentionSelector.
Fail closed if no feasible candidate can be promoted.

provenance.claim: Pre-migration Strategy C used a terminal ga~step loop after constructing the deterministic initial population.
Complete replacement caller uses bounded planning, MLObjectiveFitnessAdapter and ga~run.
Migration rationale and preserved cache/budget semantics.
Latest supplied recovered-audio caller inherited for A/B/C/D/E semantics.
Adds Strategy P constrained-Pareto path while retaining supplied A/B/C/D/E paths.
Recovered-audio resemblance, pre-limiter over-range and post-limiter clipping remain independent Pareto objectives.
